description: Source code for RDKLoggerAgent class implementation, including functions for logging, environment variable management, and configuration handling within the RDK platform.

classes.name: RDKBLoggerAgent
classes.description: Class implementing logging and environment management functions for RDK platform.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Registers wrapper functions with the agent for scripting use.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Sets up necessary pre-requisites, including creating configuration files and initializing the logger.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Resets pre-requisites, such as deleting configuration files and de-initializing the logger.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Init
methods.description: Handles initialization request, responds with success or failure.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Dbg_Enabled_Status
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level for a module is enabled.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGet
methods.description: Retrieves the logging level value of a module's environment variable.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGetNum
methods.description: Gets the registered number of an environment variable for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGetValueFromNum
methods.description: Gets the logging level value based on environment variable's registered number.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGetModFromNum
methods.description: Gets the module name associated with a registered environment variable number.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_CheckMPELogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if EnableMPELog is set to TRUE.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_All
methods.description: Logs all levels of messages for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_None
methods.description: Verifies that no logs are generated at any level for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_Trace
methods.description: Logs trace level messages for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_InverseTrace
methods.description: Verifies that no trace level logs are generated for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_Msg
methods.description: Logs a custom message at a specified level for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_SetLogLevel
methods.description: Stub for setting log level, currently returns failure.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_GetLogLevel
methods.description: Stub for getting log level, currently returns failure.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_MPEOSDisabled
methods.description: Disables MPEOS debug support, reinitializes logger with updated config, and logs a test message.

methods.name: CreateObject
methods.description: Factory function to create a new RDKBLoggerAgent object.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks, currently just logs cleanup.

methods.name: DestroyObject
methods.description: Deletes the RDKBLoggerAgent object.
